parsed.why: Six-month detention without trial for 'impersonating the opposite gender', documented custody beatings, sexual abuse, forced detransition, and dating-app entrapment of foreign visitors: a trans-specific state machine reaching travellers directly.

Constitutional equality, decriminalisation and courts granting trans relief, but documented traveller friction: airport stops, railway police gender-check groping, custody abuse, passport medical exams. Assessed abuse limited, not systemic; recognition narrowing is resident-facing.

State-directed targeting: extremist designation, 101 convictions, venue raids searching and photographing patrons, eighteenfold propaganda enforcement, death in custody, no anti-discrimination recourse, 74% hostile society, transition banned.

Comprehensive trans statute, self-declaration recognition, hate-crime cover, identity-based prison placement, murder convicted, 96/100 freedom score. Resident violence prevalence and uneven service enforcement temper but don't reverse strong traveller-facing protections.

Constitutional gender-identity protection, protected bathroom access, conversion-therapy ban, low regional victimisation; prison misplacement was remedied by damages. Residual institutional lag and a pending asylum-detention case keep it just short of the top.
